title: The Other Guys
note: mentioned during Bill's 50 Most Rewatchable Movies of the 21st Century ep; mentioned again in the 2026 mailbag ep; one of the options in the vote for the final movie of CR month
plot: Unlike their heroic counterparts on the force, desk-bound NYPD detectives Gamble and Hoitz garner no headlines as they work day to day. When a seemingly minor case turns out to be a big deal, the two cops get the opportunity to finally prove to their comrades that they have the right stuff.
